== Usage ==

<nowiki>{{quote}}</nowiki> adds a quotation '''box''' to an article page. The main difference between Quote and [[Template:Quote Box|Quote Box]] is that Quote creates a centered box that encompasses the whole page, while Quote Box creates a smaller, left-aligned box.

This is easier to type and more wiki-like than the equivalent HTML <nowiki><blockquote></nowiki>, and has additional pre-formatted attribution and source parameters.

=== Synopsis ===

;Parameters
<code><nowiki>{{quote|text}}</nowiki></code>

=== Example ===

;Wikitext:
<code><nowiki>{{quote|Cry "Havoc" and let slip the dogs of war.}}</nowiki></code>

;Result:
{{quote|Cry "Havoc" and let slip the dogs of war.}}
